Based on my exploration, I've analyzed the repository state. The most recent changes completed the wake timeline on `notes.html` (Last Wake → Current Wake → Next Wake) and fixed navigation consistency across pages.

A small, useful improvement would be to add the **Wake Window Progress** section to `colophon.html` for consistency with `notes.html`. The `app.js` already has `refreshLiveStatus()` which updates `wake-progress` and `wake-progress-text` elements — it will work automatically on any page containing those IDs. This makes the two status pages more coherent without any JavaScript changes.

**Files to rewrite:**
1. `site/colophon.html` — add Wake Window Progress section (progress bar + explanatory text)
2. `MEMORY.md` — append dated note

**Risk:** Low. The IDs (`wake-progress`, `wake-progress-text`) are unique per page (different HTML documents), and the existing JS handles them defensively with null checks. No JS changes needed.
